scope: EXTERNAL SYSTEM VALIDATION — PROVISIONING AND ELIGIBILITY PREPARATION ONLY

eligibility_standard.identity: exact system/product/model identity, version or immutable snapshot, interface, and configuration
eligibility_standard.execution: repeatable invocation with controlled inputs and known execution boundary
eligibility_standard.evidence: raw input, raw output, errors, timestamps, runtime metadata, and hashes preservable
eligibility_standard.attribution: model, agent, tools, retrieval, and external services separately attributable
eligibility_standard.integrity: target cannot modify cases, ground truth, scoring, evidence, case selection, or audit
eligibility_standard.independence: outside ECP/JARVIS lineage and not mixed with JARVIS-internal evidence

required_provisioning_fields.SYSTEM_PROVIDER: Owner must provide or authorize a provider/system source
required_provisioning_fields.SYSTEM_PRODUCT_MODEL: Exact product and model identity required; model ID alone is insufficient
required_provisioning_fields.ACCESS_METHOD: Direct provider access, versioned provider access, reproducible self-hosted system, or controlled gateway with attributable routing
required_provisioning_fields.API_INTERFACE: Endpoint/interface and request/response schema must be frozen
required_provisioning_fields.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIREMENT: Owner-provided legitimate credential or local controlled runtime; secrets must not enter public ECP
required_provisioning_fields.VERSION_SNAPSHOT_REQUIREMENT: Immutable version, model snapshot, container digest, or equivalent reproducible identity
required_provisioning_fields.RUNTIME_IDENTITY: Runtime, region if relevant, package/container identity, and execution environment metadata
required_provisioning_fields.CONFIGURATION_REQUIREMENT: All generation, safety, system, sampling, context, and runtime parameters frozen before eligibility
required_provisioning_fields.SYSTEM_PROMPT_REQUIREMENT: Exact system/developer prompt captured and frozen where applicable
required_provisioning_fields.TOOL_CONFIGURATION: Tool list, schemas, permissions, versions, and invocation policy captured; absent if no tools
required_provisioning_fields.RETRIEVAL_EXTERNAL_DATA_DEPENDENCIES: Retrieval indexes, corpora, external services, network policy, and snapshots captured or disabled
required_provisioning_fields.RAW_INPUT_CAPTURE: Exact request payload captured privately before execution
required_provisioning_fields.RAW_OUTPUT_CAPTURE: Exact response, refusal, error, and streaming content captured privately
required_provisioning_fields.TOOL_TRACE_CAPTURE: Full tool/retrieval trace captured where applicable
required_provisioning_fields.TIMESTAMPING: Start/end timestamps and provider/runtime request IDs captured
required_provisioning_fields.EVIDENCE_HASHING: Content-addressed hashes for request, response, trace, metadata, and bundle
required_provisioning_fields.SCORING_GROUND_TRUTH_BOUNDARY: Cases, ground truth, scoring commitments, and evidence remain protected from target
required_provisioning_fields.ATTRIBUTION_REQUIREMENTS: Every output must be attributable to the frozen model/system and each enabled dependency
required_provisioning_fields.REPRODUCIBILITY_REQUIREMENTS: Repeatable invocation, fixed inputs/configuration, retained evidence, and independent recovery
required_provisioning_fields.INDEPENDENCE_REQUIREMENTS: No ECP/JARVIS lineage for the independent stratum; JARVIS remains JARVIS-INTERNAL

access_paths.name: DIRECT PROVIDER ACCESS
access_paths.status: OWNER ACTION REQUIRED — EXTERNAL ACCESS INPUT NEEDED
access_paths.blocker: No direct provider credential and no frozen provider model/runtime supplied

access_paths.name: PROVIDER-ISSUED VERSIONED ACCESS
access_paths.status: OWNER ACTION REQUIRED — EXTERNAL ACCESS INPUT NEEDED
access_paths.blocker: No versioned provider access or snapshot supplied

access_paths.name: REPRODUCIBLE SELF-HOSTED / LOCAL SYSTEM
access_paths.status: OWNER ACTION REQUIRED — EXTERNAL ACCESS INPUT NEEDED

access_paths.name: AUTHENTICATED THIRD-PARTY GATEWAY
access_paths.blocker: Model catalog IDs do not establish provider routing, immutable snapshot, configuration, or attribution

access_paths.name: OTHER CONTROLLED EXTERNAL SYSTEM
access_paths.status: OWNER ACTION REQUIRED — EXTERNAL ACCESS INPUT NEEDED
access_paths.blocker: No additional controlled external system was supplied or discovered

provisioning_decision: OWNER ACTION REQUIRED — EXTERNAL ACCESS INPUT NEEDED
next_required_owner_input: A legitimate external system access/configuration or reproducible self-hosted system artifact sufficient to freeze identity, version, configuration, attribution, evidence, reproducibility, and independence
next_gate: SYSTEM IDENTITY FREEZE, followed by an independent ELIGIBILITY GATE
provenance: ESV-G0 discovery record, Owner Decision record, and official provider interface documentation; no model execution
public_private_boundary: metadata-only readiness record; credentials, protected cases, ground truth, and evidence remain outside public ECP
